Oracle Fusion HCM 26C: what changed

We track 25 HCM changes in 26C, out of 292 features (our count) in Oracle's 26C What's New documents for this area. 25 of them are delivered switched on; 0 need setup or an opt-in before anyone can use them.

Local Tax Jurisdiction Sync on Tax Withholding Card

Impact: high (draft)Automatically onHCMPayroll · Payroll for the United States
We have enhanced the sync of local tax jurisdictions to the employee’s Tax Withholding card to provide more consistent, controlled, and auditable behavior. When you create or update a valid address (latitude/longitude present), the system automatically synchronizes any affected local tax jurisdictions from the Tax Jurisdiction card to the following regional components on the tax card.

Additional Extensibility for Redwood Add Absence

Impact: medium (draft)Automatically onHCMAbsence Management · Absence Management
You can now use Visual Builder studios to further extend the Redwood absence entry page. Extend the enhanced Redwood Absence entry page which now supports guided journeys, setting up of default values, and allows to show or hide buttons based on user roles.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Compensatory Time Interface Enhancements

Impact: medium (draft)Automatically onHCMAbsence Management · Absence Management
Two new enhancements to the compensatory time integration are being introduced in this release. With this enhancement, when customers use the Timecard Approval ELA task, compensatory time earned entries are now sent to Absence Management as soon as each individual time entry is approved.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Display Unpaid Break when Absence is Entered on the Timecard

Impact: medium (draft)Automatically onHCMAbsence Management · Absence Management
Previously, we introduced a feature in 26B to display unpaid break on the absence Redwood pages when the break is automatically deducted from the absence duration.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Invalid Dates are Disabled in the Date Picker

Impact: medium (draft)Automatically onHCMAbsence Management · Absence Management
When you enter absences against past or future assignments using the enhanced Redwood pages, the date picker now allows selection of only the valid dates for the chosen assignment.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Optional Reason for Discretionary Disbursements

Impact: medium (draft)Automatically onHCMAbsence Management · Absence Management
You can now configure absence plans to mandate reason selection when disbursing balances. You can define your list of acceptable reasons using the new ORA_ANC_DISBURSEMENT_REASONS lookup code.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Prevent Withdrawal of Previously Approved Absences

Impact: medium (draft)Automatically onHCMAbsence Management · Absence Management
Previously, if an employee edited and resubmitted an already approved absence, the status changed to Awaiting Approval status and the employee could withdraw the absence without the manager's approval.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Use VB Studio to Restrict Access to Past and Future Assignments

Impact: medium (draft)Automatically onHCMAbsence Management · Absence Management
Absence Management enables users to record absences for past assignments that concluded within the last year, as well as, for all active future assignments. You can now further refine these options using two new page properties in the Visual Builder Studio.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Configure Rules for Benefits Redwood Page Properties

Impact: medium (draft)Automatically on (setup may apply)HCMBenefits · Benefits
